Steeveyboy/feature-creep.title: Require a signed-off PRD before `suggestFeature()` may suggest a feature
Steeveyboy/feature-creep.user_story: As a director of product operations, I want `src/core.js` to block `suggestFeature()` until a product requirements document has been approved in the options page, so that our feature suggestions are themselves properly suggested.
Steeveyboy/feature-creep.why_now: The README says reliability matters more than features, yet `extension/content.js` currently lets any individual contributor click the button with zero governance. Every unreviewed click is roadmap risk.
acceptance_criteria: `extension/options.html` gains a 14-field PRD form with a mandatory 'Strategic Alignment' section
`suggestFeature()` in `src/core.js` rejects with `PRD_NOT_APPROVED` until two stakeholders have signed off
`config.js` gains a `spinnerMessages` entry reading 'Awaiting sign-off...' that is shown for a minimum of three business days
`scripts/try.mjs` supports a `--skip-governance` flag that is documented as deprecated on release

react/react.title: Add a loading spinner while `useState` decides on the initial state
react/react.user_story: As a frontend engineer, I want `useState` in `packages/react/src/ReactHooks.js` to display a branded loading spinner while it resolves its initial value, so that users feel reassured something is happening during those microseconds.
react/react.why_now: The README promises that React makes it 'painless to create interactive UIs', but state initialization currently offers no visual feedback at all. Competitors are shipping skeleton screens for far less.
acceptance_criteria: `useState` accepts an optional third return value, `isDeciding`, that is always `false`
A spinner is committed by `packages/react-reconciler/src/ReactFiberWorkLoop.js` and removed in the same tick
The spinner is configurable through a new `<StateLoadingProvider>` wrapped around the whole app
`packages/react/README.md` documents the feature under a new 'Delight' heading
